mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document (id, title, source, doc_type, chunk_count, content, create_time, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{source}, #{docType}, #{chunkCount}, #{content}, #{createTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_document SET title = #{title}, source = #{source}, doc_type = #{docType}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, content = #{content} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE kb_document SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_document WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM kb_document WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM kb_document WHERE doc_type = #{docType} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
